note: Between Horizons (I027, The Cost of the Wind): the running costs of a life afloat, in one place. Read by Economy (src/core/economy.gd). Prices are gameplay numbers in euros, scaled by the difficulty's 'costs' factor (Difficulty), not claims about real harbours. Fuel: price per litre by the harbour's region (HarbourDressing.archetype_for) and a small harbour's extra; each boat's tank and its burn at cruising revs (the engine's speed in VesselProfile). Harbour dues: per metre of the boat's length per night moored in a harbour (by the harbour's service tier and region); a short stop under grace_hours pays nothing; anchoring is free. Existing prices stay where they were (provisions: GameSession.PROVISION_PRICE_PER_DAY; boat care: data/boat/equipment.json and BoatCare; boats: data/vessels/*.tres; chandlery: data/harbours/trades/trades.json, data/electronics/instrument_packages.json) - measured before any is changed.
